ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the skill. When it matches a stored skill, that skill is updated. Otherwise a new skill is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Enabled.description: Whether the skill can be selected by agents and queues.

Properties.description: Extension data other features attach to the skill, keyed by the name of the settings object (for example channel-specific routing settings). When present, it replaces the stored extension data as a whole.

Skills.description: The Contact Center skills to create or update.
